## ProofService.createProposal() method

Create a [ProposePresentationMessage](./core.proposepresentationmessage.md) not bound to an existing presentation exchange. To create a proposal as response to an existing presentation exchange, use [ProofService.createProposalAsResponse()](./core.proofservice.createproposalasresponse.md).

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
createProposal(connectionRecord: ConnectionRecord, presentationProposal: PresentationPreview, config?: {
        comment?: string;
        autoAcceptProof?: AutoAcceptProof;
    }): Promise<ProofProtocolMsgReturnType<ProposePresentationMessage>>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter            | Type                                                                                  | Description                                                        |
| -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| connectionRecord     | [ConnectionRecord](./core.connectionrecord.md)                                        | The connection for which to create the presentation proposal       |
| presentationProposal | [PresentationPreview](./core.presentationpreview.md)                                  | The presentation proposal to include in the message                |
| config               | { comment?: string; autoAcceptProof?: [AutoAcceptProof](./core.autoacceptproof.md); } | <i>(Optional)</i> Additional configuration to use for the proposal |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[ProofProtocolMsgReturnType](./core.proofprotocolmsgreturntype.md)&lt;[ProposePresentationMessage](./core.proposepresentationmessage.md)&gt;&gt;

Object containing proposal message and associated proof record
